script: Write-Host '=== Python env on Windows ==='; foreach ($cmd in @('python','python3','py')) { Write-Host "--- $cmd ---"; try { & $cmd --version 2>&1 } catch { Write-Host "not found: $cmd" } }; Write-Host '--- key packages on default python ---'; python -c "import sys; print('python', sys.version); [print(m, ':', __import__(m).__version__ if hasattr(__import__(m),'__version__') else 'ok') for m in ['numpy','scipy','pygltflib','trimesh','open3d','PIL']]" 2>&1
